
```{r}
library(tibble)
sales <- tribble(
    ~prod, ~year, ~sales,
    "A", 2024, 10,
    "A", 2025, 20,
    "A", 2026, 30,
    "B", 2024, 33,
    "B", 2025, 22,
    "C", 2025, 25,
    "C", 2026, 35
)
sales
```


```{r}
library(tidyr)
sales |> 
    pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = sales, values_fill = 0)
```
